record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace global masked-target loss averaging with per-sequence averaging: compute existing temperature-0.8 cross-entropy for each masked target, average within each sequence, then average across sequences. This gives uniformly sampled users equal loss weight rather than favoring histories with more masked targets. Preserve masking, sampling, features, embeddings, topology, readout, optimizer and training schedule.
